moments.title: Premier League Returns
moments.blurb: The Premier League is back after the international break with a packed schedule this weekend, including a huge clash between Manchester United and Tottenham Hotspur on Saturday, and Liverpool vs Manchester City on Sunday.

angles.name: Weekend Warm-up
angles.copy: Premier League football is back! Who's ready for a massive weekend of action? Man Utd v Spurs on Saturday, then Liverpool v Man City on Sunday. Get in!

angles.name: Big Game Buzz
angles.copy: It's the fixture everyone's talking about! Manchester United take on Tottenham Hotspur at 5:30 PM BST on Saturday. Predict the score!

moments.title: Exeter Chiefs Home Game
moments.blurb: Exeter Chiefs play their first home Gallagher Premiership match of October against Newcastle Falcons at Sandy Park on Sunday, October 11th.

angles.name: Chiefs Match Day
angles.copy: It's match day for the Chiefs! Exeter take on Newcastle Falcons at Sandy Park on Sunday. Get down there and support the boys! Kick-off 3 PM.

angles.name: Local Rugby Buzz
angles.copy: Big game alert for Exeter Chiefs this Sunday as they welcome Newcastle Falcons to Sandy Park in the Gallagher Premiership. Who's heading to the game?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Daryl Hall
moments.blurb: Daryl Hall, the legendary singer from Hall & Oates, celebrates his 80th birthday on Sunday, October 11th.

angles.name: Hall Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Happy 80th Birthday to the one and only Daryl Hall! What's your favourite Hall & Oates track?

angles.name: Music Icon Turns 80
angles.copy: Celebrating a true music icon today! Daryl Hall of Hall & Oates turns 80. Still sounds as good as ever!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Paul Simon
moments.blurb: Acclaimed singer-songwriter Paul Simon, known for his work with Art Garfunkel and his successful solo career, turns 85 on Tuesday, October 13th.

angles.name: Simon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 85th Birthday to the legendary Paul Simon! From Simon & Garfunkel to Graceland, what's your go-to Paul Simon song?

angles.name: Graceland Memories
angles.copy: Celebrating an incredible 85 years of music from Paul Simon today! What a career.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Usher
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning R&B superstar Usher, celebrated for hits like 'Yeah!' and 'Confessions', will celebrate his 48th birthday on Wednesday, October 14th.

angles.name: Usher B-Day
angles.copy: Get ready to scream 'Yeah!' because Usher turns 48 on Wednesday! What's your favourite track from the R&B icon?

angles.name: Confessions of a Fan
angles.copy: Happy 48th Birthday to the one and only Usher on Wednesday! Still got those moves!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Eminem
moments.blurb: Global rap icon Eminem, known for his groundbreaking albums and lyrical prowess, celebrates his 54th birthday on Saturday, October 17th.

angles.name: Eminem B-Day
angles.copy: Will the real Slim Shady please stand up? Eminem turns 54 on Saturday! Drop your favourite Em track below!

angles.name: Rap God
angles.copy: Still one of the greatest to ever do it. Happy 54th Birthday to Eminem this Saturday! What an incredible career.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Travis Barker
moments.blurb: Blink-182 drummer and pop-punk icon Travis Barker celebrates his 51st birthday on Monday, October 19th.

angles.name: Travis B-Day
angles.copy: Giving it up for the incredible Travis Barker, who turns 51 on Monday! The drumming legend from Blink-182 still smashing it.

angles.name: Pop-Punk Icon
angles.copy: Happy 51st Birthday to the one and only Travis Barker this Monday! What's your favourite Blink-182 anthem?

moments.title: October Half Term Approaches
moments.blurb: Many schools across England, Wales, and Northern Ireland will begin their October half-term holiday from Monday, October 26th, with Scottish schools having their break earlier, often from October 12th.

angles.name: Half Term Countdown
angles.copy: October half-term is just around the corner for many of us! What are your plans for the school break?

angles.name: Scottish Half Term
angles.copy: It's October half-term for many schools across Scotland this week! Enjoy the break if you're off!

moments.title: Halloween Countdown
moments.blurb: The countdown to Halloween on October 31st is officially on, with spooky season well underway across the UK.

angles.name: Spooky Season
angles.copy: Only 22 days until Halloween! Who's already got their costume sorted or carved their pumpkin?

angles.name: Trick or Treat Prep
angles.copy: The spooky season is officially here! What's your favourite Halloween tradition?

moments.title: Happy Birthday David Lee Roth
moments.blurb: David Lee Roth, the iconic frontman of Van Halen, celebrates his 72nd birthday on Saturday, October 10th.

angles.name: Diamond Dave B-Day
angles.copy: Jump! It's David Lee Roth's 72nd birthday on Saturday! The one and only Diamond Dave. What's your favourite Van Halen song?

angles.name: Van Halen Legend
angles.copy: Happy 72nd Birthday to the legendary David Lee Roth this Saturday! Still bringing the energy.
